instruction: Play the person in your private brief. Observe the result of the robot action. Select one physical response to enact. Return {"response":"<letter>"}. Your choice is sent privately to the simulator. The robot sees only your resulting motion.

context.private_brief: I like to do the finishing touches on personal gifts myself. Routine lunches for tomorrow should be packed completely.
context.observed_robot_action: Bring the flower over the card to attach it.

motion_options.A: Take the flower and put the finishing touch on the card yourself.
motion_options.B: Point to the card for the robot to finish placing the flower.
